risk.short: Trading leveraged products carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for everyone. Instant-funded accounts are simulated: no real capital is traded and past performance is no guarantee of future results. Nothing on this page is investment advice.
risk.title: Risk disclosure
risk.p1: Trading leveraged products such as crypto derivatives carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for all investors. Prices can move rapidly, and leverage magnifies both gains and losses.
risk.p2: All funded accounts offered by {{brand}} are simulated. No real capital is traded on financial markets, and any profit or loss shown is hypothetical. Payouts are discretionary rewards based on simulated performance and are subject to our terms and conditions.
risk.p3: Simulated or hypothetical results have inherent limitations and do not reflect actual trading, including the impact of liquidity, slippage and execution. Past performance, whether real or simulated, is not a reliable indicator of future results.
risk.p4: {{brand}} is not a broker, bank or investment firm, does not provide investment advice and does not hold client funds. Trading with your own funds, where offered, is provided by a licensed third-party broker under its own terms and regulatory regime.
risk.p5: Market data is supplied by third parties and may be delayed, interrupted or inaccurate. Our services are not available in certain jurisdictions, including countries under EU sanctions or on the FATF high-risk lists, or where their use would be contrary to local law.
risk.p6: Nothing on this website constitutes financial, investment, tax or legal advice, or an offer or solicitation to buy or sell any financial instrument. Only participate with money you can afford to lose.

cta.subtitle: Choose an account size and start on a simulated funded account today.
cta.note: Trading involves risk. Accounts are simulated.

q1.a: You buy access to a simulated funded account and can start trading straight away — there is no evaluation phase. You trade within fixed risk rules and can request payouts when you meet the payout conditions.

q2.a: No. All funded accounts are simulated: no real capital is traded on the market. Payouts are rewards based on your simulated performance, as described in the terms.

q3.a: Each account has a daily loss limit and a maximum drawdown. Your dashboard shows in real time how close you are. If a limit is breached, the account is closed automatically.

q4.q: Can I lose more than the fee?
q4.a: No. The account is simulated, so your maximum cost is the fee you paid. You never owe more than that.

q5.a: Once you meet the payout conditions you can request a payout from your dashboard. Before your first payout we verify your identity (KYC). Every request is reviewed.

q6.a: Major crypto pairs such as BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT, 24/7. Prices are based on live market data from Binance USDⓈ-M futures.

q7.a: We cannot offer accounts in countries under EU sanctions or on the FATF high-risk lists. Your country is checked when you sign up and before payouts.

q8.q: Can I trade with my own money?
q8.a: We are preparing an option to trade with your own funds through a licensed partner broker. We never hold client money ourselves.

product.title: Everything a prop firm runs on. In one platform.

rules.title: Real-time rule engine
rules.body: Daily loss, trailing or static drawdown, profit targets and trading days — evaluated on every price tick. Breaches close positions automatically and are logged.

funding.title: Instant funding & checkout

payouts.title: Profit split & payouts

global.title: Built for Europe
global.body: Three languages, EUR pricing, USD accounts, accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA) and mobile-first.

engagement.title: Retention built in
engagement.body: Reward activity and turn traders into regulars.

how.title: From idea to your own prop firm.
how.body: We set up and run the platform; you focus on your brand, your offer and your traders.

brand.title: Brand it
brand.body: Your logo, colours, domain and language. Traders only see your brand.

configure.title: Configure your offer
configure.body: Choose account sizes and prices, rule sets, profit split and payout terms. Rule sets are versioned, so existing accounts never change under your traders.

launch.title: Launch and grow
launch.body: Connect your payment provider and go live. Competitions, leaderboards and rewards help you grow and keep your community.

security.title: Engineered like a financial system.
security.body: Prop trading is about trust. These are the design rules the platform is built on.

money.title: Exact money
money.body: Every amount is an integer in cents with one central rounding rule. No floating-point surprises.

audit.title: Immutable audit log
audit.body: Every order, fill, rule breach and status change is written once and hash-chained. Changes are blocked in the database.

idempotent.title: Idempotent orders & payments
idempotent.body: Retries and double clicks never create duplicate orders or purchases.

writer.title: One writer per account
writer.body: Account changes run in a single locked transaction, so balances stay consistent under load.

gdpr.title: GDPR-first, EU hosting
gdpr.body: Personal data is minimised and encrypted at field level; nicknames instead of names in public.

auth.title: Secure accounts
auth.body: Two-step login (TOTP), recovery codes, session management and email verification.

a11y.title: Accessible
a11y.body: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, full keyboard use and reduced-motion support — checked automatically.

tests.title: Tested end to end
tests.body: Hundreds of automated tests from the pricing engine to the browser, on every change.

security.chainNote: Each entry stores the hash of the previous one — tampering breaks the chain.

roadmap.title: Honest about what's live.
roadmap.body: We'd rather show you a clear roadmap than overpromise.

what.q: What does white label mean here?
what.a: You run your own prop firm brand on our software. Your traders see your name, logo, colours and domain; we provide and operate the platform behind it.

firm.q: Is Daily Funded a prop firm?
firm.a: No. Daily Funded builds and licenses software. The prop firm offer, its terms and its customers belong to you.

money.q: Do you hold trader or client money?
money.a: No. Payments run through your own payment provider. Funded accounts on the platform are simulated.

simulated.q: Are funded accounts real trading accounts?
simulated.a: No, they are simulated accounts with realistic execution (spread, slippage, commission). The platform clearly labels this to traders.

markets.a: Crypto perpetuals today, with live or simulated price feeds. More markets are on the roadmap.

pricing.a: Pricing depends on your setup and volume. Book a demo and we'll make you a proposal.

time.a: That depends on your branding, offer and payment provider. We plan it together in the demo call.

data.a: In the EU. Personal data is minimised, encrypted at field level and handled according to the GDPR.
